raw_output_policy.private: Original native stdout/stderr bytes remain in task scratch with raw hashes in the ledger; source/test archives remain private and unmodified.
raw_output_policy.public: Returned output copies apply declared host/task path substitutions, generic source/session identifier masking and public JWT example masking. Test execution always uses untouched original source; public output masking is never a test-source change.
raw_output_policy.classification: Sanitized copies of actual native returns; command-level private raw and public sanitized hashes remain separate.

import re,sys,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);before=(p/'baseline.lock').read_text();after=(p/'candidate.lock').read_text()
pattern=r'(?m)^pyjwt==[^\n]*(?:\n[ \t]+[^\n]*)*'
oldblock=re.search(pattern,before).group(0);newblock=re.search(pattern,after).group(0)
assert after==before.replace(oldblock,newblock,1),'bytes changed outside PyJWT block'
def declarations(s):
 out={}
 for name,kind,value in re.findall(r'(?m)^([a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+)(==| @ )([^\n]+)',s):
  out[re.sub(r'[-_.]+','-',name).lower()]=value.rstrip(' \\')
 return out
old=declarations(before);new=declarations(after)
added=sorted(set(new)-set(old));removed=sorted(set(old)-set(new))
changed=[{'name':n,'before':old[n],'after':new[n]} for n in sorted(old.keys()&new.keys()) if old[n]!=new[n]]
assert len(old)==len(new)==176 and not added and not removed
assert changed==[{'name':'pyjwt','before':'2.14.0','after':'2.15.0'}]
files=json.loads((p/'pyjwt-artifacts.json').read_text())
assert sorted(re.findall(r'--hash=sha256:([a-f0-9]+)',newblock))==sorted(x['sha256'] for x in files)
result={'before_sha256':hashlib.sha256(before.encode()).hexdigest(),'after_sha256':hashlib.sha256(after.encode()).hexdigest(),'requirements_before':len(old),'requirements_after':len(new),'unchanged_declarations_from_bd1':175,'changes':changed,'added':added,'removed':removed,'only_pyjwt_block_changed':True,'hashes_match_official_pypi':True,'retained_versions':{n:new[n] for n in ['urllib3','oauthlib','anyio','click','pypdf','soupsieve']},'pyjwt_block':newblock}
